Looking at the problem statement, the edge condition is stated as:  

> there is an undirected edge between vertices i and j if and only if  [L_i, R_i] and [L_j, R_j].

But the statement is incomplete — it doesn’t specify the relationship between the intervals.  
It likely means “if and only if the intervals intersect” (common in interval graph problems), but that’s not explicitly written.  
This is the **most critical ambiguity** because the entire graph structure depends on it — different interpretations (intersect, contain, touch at endpoints, etc.) would lead to completely different implementations.  

The other questions are either less critical (like connectivity, which is not guaranteed and must be handled anyway) or already answered by constraints (weights are positive, queries processed in given order, etc.).  

ANSWER: 1
